name.value: Yook Korean Grilled BBQ and Bistro

description.value: Yook Korean Grilled BBQ and Bistro is a sit-down Korean BBQ restaurant on Nanaimo Street in East Vancouver, where guests grill premium meats at the table alongside traditional Korean dishes. The head chef brings over 30 years of experience from home-style Korean restaurants in both South Korea and Canada, and the kitchen produces all banchan in-house. It offers a substantial, warm meal stop well-suited to hungry cyclists finishing a longer urban or cross-town ride.
